name: exported-llama-cpu
description: Serve a Llama-family GGUF exported with Unsloth or a Hugging Face converter
notes: Run from the repository root after following docs/UNSLOTH_TO_RBITNET.md. Paths are relative to the working directory. llama3 is for Llama 3 Instruct exports; use the training chat format for other models. Verify your own export's SHA-256 before serving: recipe/serve do not enforce the CLI download trusted-mode checks.
